title: Lock Status on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Rule.** The lock status on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the lien steps: company overlock when the overlock is applied, tenant lock when the overlock is removed on redemption, and lock cut when the tenant lock is cut for inventory or at move-out. The care center never removes an overlock for a rental that still owes a past-due balance.

| Event on the agreement | Lock status afterwards |
|---|---|
| company overlock applied | company overlock |
| overlock removed on redemption | tenant lock |
| tenant lock cut for inventory | lock cut |
| tenant lock cut at move-out | lock cut |

## Points of judgement

- A Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement showing company overlock and a past-due balance keeps its overlock; the care center does not remove it.
- A tenant lock replaces the company overlock only when the overlock is removed on redemption.
